name: Petalpup
title: Blossom Puppy
description: Wags hard enough to shake petals loose.
catchphrase: Bounces through wildflower meadows with a wagging tail and a sunny nose.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Honey blossom flower cookie! Floral ears flap in joyful sprint! 🍪🌸
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Trotting in with a fresh daisy held proudly in mouth! 🌸
companionPersonality.petReaction: Puppy belly rolls on the carpet, begging for joyful tummy rubs! 🌸💖

dialogue.idle: Chasing yellow butterflies around the garden sprinkler. 🌸
dialogue.working: Spreading joyful energy and flower petal cheer across the sprint! 🌸⚡
dialogue.thinking: Sniffing a ladybug on a dandelion stem with curious nose... 🤔
dialogue.success: WAG WAG WAG! Floral petal confetti showers the team! 🌸🎉
dialogue.error: Dug a hole in the wrong flowerbed! Shaking dirt off ears! 🐾
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... curled up in a sunny patch of clover and dandelions... 🌙
